photos.file: Golden Tree Snake preying on Tokay Gecko in Koh Samui, Thailand.jpg
photos.desc: A Golden Tree Snake (Chrysopelea ornata) constricting a Tokay Gecko (Gekko gecko), photographed at the Elephant Jungle Sanctuary in Maenam, Koh Samui, Thailand.
Chrysopelea ornata is a colubrid snake found in both South and Southeast Asia.
Chrysopelea ornata.The snake's striking looks and capability of gliding make it a popular choice for captivity.
